# Workforce 2.0

> AI workers for business research, drafting and workflows. Workforce provides and selects the AI behind task workflows. Users focus on the output instead of choosing models.

Pages are available as complete HTML. Outbound approvals are enabled by default and configurable. Local storage and search differ from online AI processing and optional team sharing. Prices and limits are explained on the pricing and limitations pages.

## Pages

- [A little less busy. A lot more done.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/): Give everyday work to an AI team that can research, draft and organize across your apps. Review the results and decide what happens next.
- [Choose the job you want done.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/): An engine is a ready-made workflow. It takes a business job through its steps, using your connected apps and the permissions you choose.
- [You ask. A team gets to work.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/platform/): An assistant understands your request, a planner organizes larger jobs and specialist workers use your connected tools.
- [Clear permissions. Clear boundaries.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/security/): Choose what Workforce can access, keep your files under your control and review how information is used.
- [A plan you can understand.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/pricing/): Count useful steps, not the number of AI calls behind them. Start with 300 tasks each month for free.
- [Your first job is a download away.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/download/): Install Workforce, connect the apps you choose and start with 300 free tasks each month.
- [Say what you need.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/voice/): Talk through a job, interrupt when you need to and keep going by typing whenever it suits you.
- [Keep what your business learns.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/memory/): Turn documents, decisions and past work into knowledge you can find again, in files you control.
- [A few things worth knowing.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/faq/): Straight answers about getting started, paying for work and staying in control.
- [Know what to expect.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/limits/): These are the current boundaries of the product, so you can choose the right work to give it.
- [Find the right people. Start better conversations.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/sales/): Research prospects, review the contacts and prepare outreach from your own connected accounts.
- [Turn your brand into a practical content plan.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/marketing/): Research your market, prepare posts and see which channels bring useful enquiries.
- [From a rough idea to an editable film.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/video/): Develop the story, plan the scenes and assemble the result with captions, graphics and music.
- [An inbox that feels more manageable.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/communication/): Find the requests hidden in long threads and prepare replies that sound like the right person.
- [Keep up with what competitors charge.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/pricing-intelligence/): Read public pricing pages, compare like with like and notice meaningful changes.
- [Spend time on applications worth making.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/jobs/): Find live roles that fit your experience and prepare a CV and cover letter for each one.
- [Write the articles your business can stand behind.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/seo/): Find useful topics, draft from your own evidence and check results after publication.
- [Bring your customer relationships together.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/crm/): Use the people and companies already present in your work, then organize what happens next.
- [Understand an IPO with the working shown.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/engines/ipo/): Review filing-based analysis and a transparent model score, with clear limits on what that score means.
- [Your tools, working together.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/integrations/): Connect the accounts you choose and give each worker access to the apps its job needs.
- [Make a workflow that fits your business.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/build/): Describe your process in everyday language, save a routine or ask for a custom engine.
- [Keep the knowledge. Share the work.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/teams/): Bring your team’s decisions, reference material and routines into a shared place the business can keep.
- [Choose the help that fits the job.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/compare/): Workforce is most useful for repeatable execution across your tools. Some work still benefits from a conversation, an agency or a person.
- [Ideas for a less busy working day.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/blog/): Practical guides to using AI for the work around your business.
- [A practical way to run your marketing with AI.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/blog/ai-marketing-engineer/): Bring research, planning and content production together while keeping the final say over your brand.
- [A calmer way to prepare job applications.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/blog/ai-job-search-tools/): Check that roles are live, match them to your experience and spend your effort on documents you can stand behind.
- [Build a sales process you can actually follow.](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/blog/ai-sales-tools/): Connect prospect research, thoughtful drafts and approved outreach without losing track of the human follow-up.
- [Privacy Notice](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/legal/privacy/): How your information is handled, and the rights you have.
- [Terms of Service](https://workforce.trackmystartup.com/legal/terms/): The agreement covering your use of Workforce.
